_comment: Formations are now created per-instance via instQuartet() in monster-factory.js — pass any solo def from monsters.json and the system handles per-sub HP/XP/drops automatically. This file is reserved for bespoke group defs (e.g. monsters that should only ever spawn as a fixed-size group).

summoned_crow.name: Summoned Crow
summoned_crow.description: Lesser corvids conjured from shadow to harry intruders. Frail on their own, they descend in shrieking flocks — pecking and clawing until driven off. Little more than feathered fodder for their wizard masters.
